title: RNA-seq analysis of the DTA-injured retina
study_summary: The goal of this study is to identify genes upregulated in the DTA-injured retina.

experimental_design.overall_design: Retinal mRNA profiles of retina harvested from 8-week-old control (DTAwt) or DTA (DTAmut) mice at day 1 or 5 post-injury were generated by deep-sequencing with Illumina Sequencer.
experimental_design.experimental_type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing

extraction_protocol: RNA was harvested retinas using Sepazol reagent. The RNA-seq library was constructed using the mRNA-seq sample preparation kit (Illumina).
RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols.

data_processing: CASAVA-1.8.2 (for d5 samples) and bcl2fastq-1.8.4 (for d1 samples) used for basecalling with default parameters

Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to the mouse mm9 reference genome assembly with the option (--coverage-search --max-multihits 50).
FPKM (Fragments Per Kilobase of transcript per Million mapped reads) with Cufflinks ver. 2.1.1 with the default option.
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include FPKM values for each Sample.
